pipeline_steps.label: Fetch Memory Context
pipeline_steps.description: Retrieve existing action items, decisions, budgets, and similar past meetings for LLM context

pipeline_steps.label: Summarize
pipeline_steps.description: Generate and store a structured meeting summary

pipeline_steps.label: Analyze
pipeline_steps.description: Analyze topics, sentiment, entities, and follow-ups

pipeline_steps.label: Review & Approve Delivery
pipeline_steps.description: Pause pipeline for user to review transcript, summary, analysis and confirm or change delivery options

pipeline_steps.label: Save to Memory
pipeline_steps.description: Persist meeting to semantic and ephemeral memory

pipeline_steps.label: Deliver via Email
pipeline_steps.description: Send meeting summary, analysis, and attendee data via email (transcript excluded)

pipeline_steps.label: Save to Drive
pipeline_steps.description: Save meeting summary and analysis to Google Drive

pipeline_steps.label: Create Trello Cards
pipeline_steps.description: Create action items as Trello cards

pipeline_hints.transcribe_refine: Next: Call `transcribe_get_transcript` to retrieve the refined speaker-labeled transcript.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_get_transcript: Next: Call `transcribe_summarize` to generate and store a structured meeting summary.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_summarize: Next: Call `transcribe_analyze` to analyze topics, sentiment, entities, and follow-ups.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_analyze: Next: If delivery review is enabled, call `transcribe_approve_delivery` to pause and let the user review before saving. Otherwise call `transcribe_save_context`.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_approve_delivery: Next: After user approves, call `transcribe_save_context` to persist meeting to semantic and ephemeral memory.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_save_context: Next: Call `transcribe_prepare_delivery` to package results for delivery destinations.
pipeline_hints.transcribe_prepare_delivery: Next: Call `send_delivery_email` to validate recipient emails. send results via email.
pipeline_hints.send_delivery_email: Pipeline complete. Call a delivery tool (send_delivery_email, save_to_drive, create_trello_action_items) or finish.
